title: GTS Validation Result
description:
Structured output schema for validation agents. Passed via --json-schema to constrain agent output. Contains per-criterion pass/fail results with type-specific evidence fields.

Evidence field requirements by check_type:

  http:         status_code, url, response_excerpt
  http+dom:     status_code, url, dom_selector, element_text
  browser+db:   action_performed, sql_query, row_count, sample_row
  api+response: status_code, url, method, response_body_excerpt
  process:      process_name, pid_or_status, log_excerpt
  screenshot:   screenshot_path, observations
  regression:   test_command, exit_code, test_count, failure_count
  quality:      commands_run, exit_code, error_count

The orchestrator validates that evidence fields are populated. Empty or generic evidence (e.g. 'looks good') is treated as a validation failure.

status.description: Overall validation result. 'pass' only if ALL criteria pass.

criterion.description: The behaviour statement being verified, copied from the validation checkpoint.

status.description: Whether this individual criterion passed or failed.

evidence.description: Concrete, provable evidence supporting the status. Required fields vary by check_type. See schema description for the per-type field requirements.

evidence_http.description: Evidence fields required for 'http' check type.

response_excerpt.description: Excerpt from the HTTP response body.

evidence_http_dom.description: Evidence fields required for 'http+dom' check type.

dom_selector.description: CSS selector used to find the element.

element_text.description: Text content of the matched DOM element.

evidence_browser_db.description: Evidence fields required for 'browser+db' check type.

action_performed.description: Description of the browser action performed.

sql_query.description: SQL query used to verify database state.

row_count.description: Number of rows returned by the query.

sample_row.description: A representative row from the query result.

evidence_api_response.description: Evidence fields required for 'api+response' check type.

method.description: HTTP method used (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.).

evidence_process.description: Evidence fields required for 'process' check type.

process_name.description: Name of the process being checked.

log_excerpt.description: Relevant excerpt from the process logs.

evidence_screenshot.description: Evidence fields required for 'screenshot' check type.

observations.description: Description of what was observed in the screenshot.

evidence_regression.description: Evidence fields required for 'regression' check type.

test_command.description: The test command that was executed.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the test command.

evidence_quality.description: Evidence fields required for 'quality' check type.

commands_run.description: List of quality check commands that were run.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the quality check.
